title: Pricing Harness – Analysis Result
description: Output of the Pricing Engine for one Client Input. Dashboard, Report, and Quotation all read this document only — they never recompute. Every computed number is wrapped as {value, status, unit}; module-level blocks (mode_a, mode_b, mode_c, bep, blended) carry their own top-level status.

client_input_ref.description: Path or identifier of the Client Input document this result was computed from.

client_input_checksum.description: Optional hash of the Client Input, for traceability/cache-invalidation.

blended.description: Reserved for whole-contract unit economics across all price_components (e.g. combined HW+SaaS view). Not implemented — status is NOT_IMPLEMENTED until built.

mode_b.description: MODE B is implemented (core/engine/modes/mode_b.py) and always produces a full per_component/warnings result — a Client Input with no target_contribution_margin_rate still gets status INCOMPLETE with every metric UNKNOWN, not a NOT_IMPLEMENTED stub. NOT_IMPLEMENTED is reserved for modules that genuinely have no code yet (mode_c, bep, blended).

mode_c.description: MODE C is implemented (core/engine/modes/mode_c.py) and always produces a full per_component/warnings result, mirroring mode_b's pattern — a Client Input with no target_market_price/target_contribution_margin_rate still gets status INCOMPLETE with every metric UNKNOWN, not a NOT_IMPLEMENTED stub. NOT_IMPLEMENTED is reserved for modules that genuinely have no code yet (bep, blended).

bep.description: BEP is implemented (core/engine/modes/bep.py) and always returns status/per_component/warnings, mirroring mode_b/mode_c's pattern. Single-component only in v0.1: a Client Input with more than one product.price_components entry gets status ERROR, per_component {}, and a single MULTI_COMPONENT_BEP_NOT_SUPPORTED warning — see docs/features/bep/SPEC.md section 11.

missing_input_paths.description: Flat list of Client Input field paths that were null and therefore blocked at least one metric. Convenience summary for Dashboard badge counts — the authoritative detail lives in each module's warnings[].

module_status.description: Module-level status only (mode_a/mode_b/mode_c/bep/blended top status). Never used on an individual metric.

metric_status.description: Per-metric status. OK = every dependency resolved. UNKNOWN = a required dependency is missing (null). ESTIMATED = computed using an assumed/default value rather than a confirmed input (must be cited in warnings). NOT_APPLICABLE = this metric has no meaning for this component/product shape. ERROR = a dependency was present but computation still failed (e.g. contradictory inputs).

code.description: e.g. MISSING_DEPENDENCY, DOWNSTREAM_UNKNOWN, ESTIMATED_VALUE_USED, NOT_APPLICABLE, CALCULATION_ERROR.

metric_path.description: Dot/bracket path of the affected metric within this Analysis Result document.

dependency_paths.description: Path(s) this metric depends on — may point into the Client Input document (e.g. costs.items[bom].amount) or into this Analysis Result itself (e.g. mode_a.per_component.hardware.gross_profit), for propagated warnings.

per_component.description: Keyed by component_id from the source Client Input's product.price_components.

mode_b_component_metrics.description: MODE B (Target Price) per-component output — see docs/features/mode_b_target_price/SPEC.md.

mode_b_block.description: The actual shape of the top-level mode_b property (see mode_b_component_metrics above) — MODE B always runs and always returns per_component/warnings, even when every metric is UNKNOWN.

per_component.description: Keyed by component_id from the source Client Input's product.price_components.

mode_c_component_metrics.description: MODE C (Allowable Direct Cost) per-component output — see docs/features/mode_c_allowable_cost/SPEC.md. allowable_direct_cost never depends on actual_direct_cost/direct_cost_gap (SPEC.md §9's dependency isolation) — a problem on the direct-cost side never blocks allowable_direct_cost, and vice versa.

mode_c_block.description: The actual shape of the top-level mode_c property (see mode_c_component_metrics above) — MODE C always runs and always returns per_component/warnings, even when every metric is UNKNOWN.

per_component.description: Keyed by component_id from the source Client Input's product.price_components.

bep_component_metrics.description: BEP (Break-Even Point) per-component output — see docs/features/bep/SPEC.md. contribution_margin_per_unit follows MODE A's Contribution Margin semantics exactly (net sales ex VAT − product/service direct cost − variable selling/delivery costs; fixed_operating_cost excluded). break_even_quantity_exact is NOT_APPLICABLE (never a raw 0 or negative number, value null) whenever contribution_margin_per_unit is OK and <= 0 — see SPEC.md section 6/9 for the full FC x CMu sign matrix.

analysis_period_basis.description: The single cost_item.basis (e.g. "per_month") every fixed_operating_cost item contributing to this component's fixed_operating_cost metric shares — the analysis period BEP's break_even_quantity_exact is implicitly scoped to (SPEC.md section 4/12). This is period CONTEXT, not a metric, and never a quantity unit. null means no fixed_operating_cost item exists for this component at all (fixed_operating_cost is then a confirmed 0, OK — not UNKNOWN, not a missing-data signal on this field) — distinct from an inconsistent-basis ERROR, which is instead surfaced via fixed_operating_cost's own status/warnings, not via this field.

bep_block.description: The actual shape of the top-level bep property (see bep_component_metrics above) — BEP always runs and always returns per_component/warnings, even when every metric is UNKNOWN. per_component is {} specifically (and only) when status=ERROR with code MULTI_COMPONENT_BEP_NOT_SUPPORTED (more than one product.price_components entry) — see docs/features/bep/SPEC.md section 11.

per_component.description: Keyed by component_id from the source Client Input's product.price_components. Empty object when BEP refused to run (multi-component gate).
